paragraphs: The red cat sits on the mat. The cat is big and fat. The mat is soft and warm.
The cat likes to play with a ball. The ball is blue and small.
The cat runs and jumps. The cat is very happy today.

The dog likes to jump and play. The dog has a red ball.
The dog is a good boy. The dog is happy and strong.

I like the sun. The sun makes me happy and warm.
The sun is good. The sun helps the plants grow.

paragraphs: The little fish swims in the water. The fish is blue and small. The water is clean and cool.
The fish likes to play with friends. The friends are little fish too.
The fish is very happy. The fish swims all day.

readings.title: My Family
paragraphs: My family is big. I have a mom and a dad. My mom is nice and kind.
I have a brother and a sister. My brother is tall. My sister is small.
We are a happy family. We play and we laugh. I love my family.

paragraphs: The blue bird flies in the sky. The bird is small and fast. The bird has blue wings.
The bird likes to sing. The bird sings all day. The song is nice.
The bird is happy. The bird flies home. Home is a big tree.

paragraphs: The happy frog jumps on the grass. The frog is green and small. The grass is soft and green.
The frog likes the water. The frog can swim and jump.
The frog is a good swimmer. The frog is happy and fast.

The bear likes honey. The bear eats a lot of honey. The honey is sweet and good.
The bear is happy. The bear goes to sleep. The bear is a big friend.

readings.title: The Green Tree
paragraphs: The green tree is in the park. The tree is tall and big. The park is nice and clean.
The tree has many leaves. The leaves are green and small.
The birds like the tree. The birds sing in the tree. The tree is a happy home.

readings.title: My Toys
paragraphs: I have many toys. I have a red car and a blue ball. The car is fast and fun.
I like to play with my toys. My toys are fun and new.
I play every day. I share my toys with my friends. We are happy.
